fitting: June-July heads; August temperature; September untouched evaluation; frozen April-May neural
gap_inputs: Training alternates clean and causally reconstructed input by candidate; labels always real observed future
future_rule: First future M1 opens at origin. Both touched same minute => SL first (conservative, intraminute order unknown).
release_gate: Finite normalized forecasts for all four assets; correct exact geometry and no entry-policy changes; heldout NLL and Brier <=110% geometry-only baseline
limitations: M1 cannot resolve very close-barrier ordering. Wide tail distances have few/no touches; no eventual-hit or profitability claim. Dependent queries, not independent trades.
